outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS...POTENTIALLY VERY LARGE HAIL...AND PERHAPS ONE OR TWO TORNADOES ARE FORECAST TO AFFECT PORTIONS OF EASTERN MONTANA AND WESTERN NORTH DAKOTA THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH TONIGHT. ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ANTICIPATED FROM PORTIONS OF NEW ENGLAND TO THE MID-ATLANTIC WESTWARD TO IOWA.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A MID-LEVEL CYCLONE WILL TRACK NNEWD FROM PORTIONS OF WA TO ALBERTA...WHILE A RIDGE AMPLIFIES FROM PARTS OF THE GREAT PLAINS NWD OVER THE CANADIAN PRAIRIES. A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OFF THE CA COAST WILL APPROACH THE PACIFIC COAST...WHILE A LONG FETCH OF SSWLY FLOW E OF THE CYCLONE AND SHORTWAVE TROUGH ENCOURAGES THE NNEWD PROGRESSION OF A CONVECTIVELY ENHANCED VORT MAX PRESENTLY AFFECTING THE LOWER CO RIVER VALLEY. FARTHER TO THE E...A LOW-AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCE WILL QUICKLY PROGRESS ACROSS PARTS OF THE ERN GREAT LAKES REGION AND MOVE OFF THE ATLANTIC COAST...WHILE A DEEPER UPSTREAM PERTURBATION AND ACCOMPANYING SPEED MAX MOVE ESEWD ACROSS PARTS OF ONTARIO AND QUEBEC.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF THE NRN GREAT PLAINS
sections.text: THE STRONG LOW-LEVEL MASS RESPONSE RELATED TO FORCING FOR ASCENT PRECEDING THE AFOREMENTIONED VORT MAX AND THE GLANCING INFLUENCE OF THE NWRN CONUS/SWRN CANADA MIGRATORY CYCLONE WILL FAVOR SFC CYCLOGENESIS OVER SERN/E-CNTRL MT THROUGH THE DAY. THE STRENGTHENING CIRCULATION SURROUNDING THE SFC CYCLONE WILL SUPPORT AN INFLUX OF RELATIVELY ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE -- SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 50S TO LOWER 60S -- WITHIN A NARROW CORRIDOR EXTENDING INTO ERN MT FROM THE DAKOTAS. THE 00Z RIW RAOB SAMPLED A 700-MB TEMP AROUND 16.5C -- HIGHLIGHTING THE WARM EML THAT WILL BE OVERSPREADING THE MOISTURE CORRIDOR. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT THE MOST PROBABLE CONVECTIVE SCENARIO WILL BE FOR RELATED CAPPING TO CONFINE DIURNAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT TO THE PROXIMITY OF MODEST MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS OVERSPREADING RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ACROSS CNTRL/ERN MT. THIS ACTIVITY WOULD THEN SPREAD NNEWD/NEWD INTO/ACROSS PARTS OF WRN ND THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. HIGH-BASED CONVECTION COULD ALSO DEVELOP WITHIN A SOMEWHAT MORE SPATIALLY SEPARATE REGIME FROM THE DEEP BOUNDARY LAYER IN NERN WY/SERN MT/NWRN SD ON THE EDGE OF THE VORT MAX. SUCH ACTIVITY COULD EVOLVE INTO NNEWD-SPREADING MULTICELL CLUSTERS THROU

sections.title: PORTIONS OF NRN UT TO CNTRL WY
sections.text: WITH H5 SSWLY FLOW AROUND 35-40 KT TRAILING TO THE SW OF THE VORT MAX...SUFFICIENT MID-LEVEL MOISTURE AND BUOYANCY WILL BE PRESENT FOR SEMI-ORGANIZED/HIGH-BASED CONVECTION TO PRODUCE LOCALLY/MARGINALLY SVR WINDS.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF NEW ENGLAND AND THE MID-ATLANTIC WWD TO IA
sections.text: SHOWERS AND ISOLATED TSTMS WILL LIKELY BE CROSSING PORTIONS OF NY AND VICINITY DURING THE MORNING IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE LOW-AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCE. ASCENT ACCOMPANYING THIS FEATURE WILL LIKELY BE -- AT LEAST INITIALLY -- DISPLACED TO THE E/NE OF RICHER BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE/STRONGER INSTABILITY...WITH LITTLE IN THE WAY OF A SVR RISK ANTICIPATED DURING THE MORNING. BY MID-AFTERNOON...SOME INTENSIFICATION OF CONVECTION MAY OCCUR AS IT SPREADS ACROSS PARTS OF SRN NY AND SRN NEW ENGLAND AND INTERCEPTS A FEED OF MOISTURE FROM THE W YIELDING DESTABILIZATION. ADDITIONAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS ALSO ANTICIPATED DURING THE AFTERNOON ALONG AN AXIS OF WEAK CONVERGENCE/DIFFUSE FRONT TRAILING WWD INTO PARTS OF IA. ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED SVR WIND/HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY INTO EARLY EVENING. THE SEPARATE SLGT AREAS ACCOUNT FOR SOMEWHAT GREATER ASCENT/LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND STRONGER DEEP SHEAR RELATED TO THE LOW-AMPLITUDE IMPULSE ACROSS THE ERN AREA...AND GREATER BUOYANCY -- E.G. MLCAPE AROUND 1500-2500 J/KG -- ACROSS THE WRN AREA. HOWEVER...MUCH OF THE REGION WILL RESIDE BETWEEN ZONES OF STRONGER ASCENT ACCOMPANYING THE LOW-AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCE AND DEEPER UPSTREAM PERTURBAT

sections.title: PORTIONS OF THE SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: CLUSTERS OF STRONG TSTMS WILL LIKELY FORM OVER THE SRN ROCKIES AND THEN DRIFT ACROSS THE ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS WHERE ANTECEDENT DEEP MIXING WILL SUPPORT A FEW STRONG DOWNDRAFTS. WEAK DEEP SHEAR WILL MITIGATE CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION...PRECLUDING THE INCLUSION OF SVR PROBABILITIES. ..COHEN/GLEASON.. 06/11/2016

sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM PARTS OF THE GREAT BASIN ACROSS THE NORTHERN ROCKIES... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE MID/UPPER MS VALLEY INTO SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND...

sections.title: NEW ENGLAND INTO PA/NJ
sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOP SHOWS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING ACROSS EASTERN ONTARIO...WITH AN ASSOCIATED CLUSTER OF SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS AFFECTING CENTRAL NY. THIS ACTIVITY WILL TRACK EASTWARD EARLY TODAY INTO SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND...HELPING TO MAINTAIN CLOUDS AND A RELATIVELY COOL/DRY ENVIRONMENT. HOWEVER SOUTH OF THESE STORMS...A FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC SETUP IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP BY MID-LATE AFTERNOON AS DEWPOINTS RISE INTO THE 50S AND DAYTIME HEATING CONTRIBUTES TO MODERATE CAPE VALES. IT APPEARS LIKELY THAT CLUSTERS OF STRONG TSTMS WILL DEVELOP OVER PARTS OF SOUTHERN NY AND NORTHERN PA...SPREADING SOUTHEASTWARD THROUGH THE SLIGHT RISK AREA DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING. HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE MAIN THREATS WITH THESE STORMS...ALTHOUGH AN ISOLATED TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT.

sections.title: MIDWEST STATES
sections.text: MORNING SATELLITE AND RADAR LOOPS SHOW A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS ONGOING OVER PARTS OF IA. THIS ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO WEAKEN DRAMATICALLY BY EARLY AFTERNOON...ALLOWING STRONG HEATING/DESTABILIZATION TO OCCUR ALONG A SURFACE BOUNDARY. THE RESULT WILL BE ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT FROM IA INTO PARTS OF NORTHERN IL/IND. THIS AREA IS BENEATH UPPER RIDGE AXIS AND FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR. A FEW SLOW-MOVING SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS ARE POSSIBLE...BUT OVERALL RISK APPEARS MARGINAL.

sections.title: NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: A SHORTWAVE TROUGH CURRENTLY OVER UT/AZ IS FORECAST TO TRACK NORTHWARD INTO THE NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS BY TONIGHT. THE RESULT WILL LIKELY BE ANOTHER CLUSTER OF SEVERE STORMS OVER PARTS OF EASTERN MT AND WESTERN ND THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. STORMS WILL INITIATE AS LARGE SCALE FORCING IMPINGES ON BETTER LOW LEVEL MOISTURE ALONG THE BIGHORNS...AND TRACK QUICKLY NORTHWARD INTO EASTERN MT. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW STRONG MID/UPPER LEVEL WINDS FAVORABLE FOR FAST-MOVING STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND VERY LARGE HAIL. THIS THREAT WILL LIKELY PERSIST MUCH OF THE EVENING AND SPREAD NORTH-NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS WESTERN ND. ..HART/LEITMAN.. 06/11/2016

ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ANTICIPATED FROM PORTIONS OF SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND TO THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION AND WESTWARD TO IOWA.

sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF THE NRN HIGH PLAINS... ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM ERN OH INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES AND SRN NEW ENGLAND... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM IA ACROSS THE SRN GREAT LAKES... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE NRN ROCKIES AND HIGH PLAINS...

sections.title: ERN MT INTO WRN ND REGION
sections.text: UPPER LOW OVER BC IS FORECAST TO MOVE SLOWLY ENEWD INTO ALBERTA THROUGH TONIGHT AS A SHORT WAVE TROUGH TRAILING SWWD FROM THE LOW EDGES EWD ACROSS THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION. IN ADVANCE OF THIS SYSTEM...A VORTICITY MAX LIFTING NNEWD FROM SERN NV/SWRN UT WITHIN A BAND OF STRONGER WINDS ALOFT IS EXPECTED TO MOVE ACROSS WRN WY INTO ERN MT LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING AND ENHANCE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM POTENTIAL OVER PARTS OF THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. AT THE SURFACE...A LOW OVER SERN MT/NERN WY WILL MOVE INTO WRN ND LATE TONIGHT...AS A COLD FRONT MOVES EWD ACROSS ERN MT AND A WARM FRONT LIFTS NWD ACROSS SD. LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE IS INCREASING INTO ERN MT WITH SURFACE DEW POINTS CURRENTLY IN THE 55-60F RANGE...AND STRONG DIABATIC HEATING COUPLED WITH PRE-EXISTING STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL RESULT IN FURTHER DESTABILIZATION WITH MLCAPE REACHING 1500-2000 J/KG LATER THIS AFTERNOON. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP OVER PARTS OF ERN MT BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON AS DYNAMIC FORCING FOR LARGE-SCALE ASCENT OVERSPREADS LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ASSOCIATED WITH SURFACE LOW AND FRONTAL BOUNDARIES. VEERING/STRENGTHENING WINDS WITH HEIGHT WILL ENHANCE STORM ORGANIZATION AND INTENSITY WITH POTENTIAL FOR SUPERCEL

sections.title: IOWA TO WRN OH
sections.text: A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS IS IN PLACE ACROSS THIS REGION INDICATING POTENTIAL FOR STRONG UPDRAFTS TO DEVELOP. HOWEVER...WITH EXCEPTION OF BOUNDARIES GENERATED FROM WEAKENING CONVECTION IN SRN IA AND AN MCV OVER NWRN IL...FORCING MECHANISMS FOR CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ARE WEAK AND WINDS ALOFT/VERTICAL SHEAR ARE MINIMAL. A FEW STRONG STORMS MAY DEVELOP WITHIN THIS ZONE WITH POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE LOCAL STRONG WIND GUSTS/HAIL BUT OVERALL THREAT APPEARS TO BE LIMITED BY THE WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR. ..WEISS/SMITH.. 06/11/2016

ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ANTICIPATED FROM PORTIONS OF SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND TO THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION AND WESTWARD TO IOWA.

sections.title: ERN MT INTO WRN ND
sections.text: FILTERED SUNSHINE IS OCCURRING ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS AMIDST A CIRRUS PLUME SPREADING NWD ACROSS ERN MT. HOWEVER...SFC TEMPERATURES HAVE STILL REACHED THE 80S TO LOWER 90S F...OVERLAPPING WITH A CORRIDOR OF RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ADVECTING FROM THE SE INTO SERN MT. LATEST THINKING IS THAT TSTMS WILL INITIATE MID-LATE AFTERNOON ACROSS FAR NERN WY INTO SERN MT...AND QUICKLY CONGEAL INTO ONE OR MORE NWD MOVING CLUSTERS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS. THESE THREATS SHOULD EXTEND NWD THIS EVENING INTO E-CNTRL MT AND SWRN ND...WITH EVENTUAL MODE EVOLUTION FAVORING A LONGER-LIVED WIND THREAT TOWARDS THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER LATER TONIGHT.

sections.title: ERN OH INTO SRN NEW ENGLAND AND THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION
sections.text: RECENT CONVECTIVE TRENDS SHOW OCCASIONAL UPWARD PULSING OF SHOWERS AND A COUPLE TSTMS WITHIN BROAD/WEAK CONVERGENCE ZONE FROM ERN OH INTO SRN NEW ENGLAND. MORE ROBUST CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT HAS BEEN LIMITED THUS FAR...BUT CONDITIONAL POTENTIAL STILL REMAINS FOR ISOLATED STRONG TO PERHAPS SVR TSTM DEVELOPMENT INTO THE LATE AFTERNOON.

sections.title: CNTRL AND SERN AZ
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS THE LOWER DESERTS OF CNTRL AND SERN AZ THIS AFTERNOON. STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AIDED BY STRONG HEATING WILL SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR LOCALIZED STRONG DOWNBURST WINDS ROUGHLY FROM MARICOPA COUNTY SEWD THIS AFTERNOON. MORNING SOUNDINGS AND RECENT VWP DATA INDICATE AROUND 20 KT OF MIDLEVEL FLOW IS PRESENT...WHICH MAY BE MARGINALLY SUFFICIENT TO MAINTAIN WEAKLY ORGANIZED STORMS. ..ROGERS.. 06/11/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1128 AM CDT SAT JUN 11 2016/

sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS SURROUNDING THE ENH RISK FROM ERN MT TO CNTRL ND... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS SURROUNDING THE SLGT RISK ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS/NRN PLAINS...

sections.title: ERN MT...WRN DAKOTAS
sections.text: ARCING LINE OF STORMS ACROSS ERN MT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE NWD THROUGHOUT THE EVENING. 00Z GGW SOUNDING REVEALS VERY STEEP EML /700-500MB LAPSE RATES NEAR 8.5 DEG C PER KM/ WITH A BASE JUST BELOW 700 MB. THE WARM TEMPERATURES ASSOCIATED WITH THIS EML AND INCREASED DIURNAL COOLING WILL RESULT IN THE ENVIRONMENT BECOMING INCREASINGLY HOSTILE TO SURFACE-BASED CONVECTION. EVEN SO...STEEP LAPSE RATES AND STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR WILL LIKELY ALLOW THE ONGOING ACTIVITY TO PERSIST EVEN AS IT BECOMES MORE ELEVATED. AS A RESULT...LARGE HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE OVERNIGHT. STRONG WIND GUSTS AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS BEFORE DIURNAL COOLING LIMITS THESE THREATS.

sections.title: MID MS VALLEY EWD TO THE NRN MID-ATLANTIC
sections.text: THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING AND THE LACK OF STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT ARE EXPECTED TO LIMIT TSTM DEVELOPMENT OVERNIGHT...PRECLUDING THE NEED TO CONTINUE ANY SEVERE PROBABILITIES IN THIS REGION.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF THE SRN PLAINS
sections.text: SUBTLE FORCING FOR ASCENT AMIDST THE WARM AND MOIST AIRMASS OVER THE REGION INITIATED TSTMS DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON. MOST OF THIS ACTIVITY HAS SHOWN LITTLE PERSISTENCE WITH THE WEAKLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT RESULTING IN QUICK STORM COLLAPSE. NEW INITIATION IS OCCURRING ALONG THE RESULTING OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES WITH SOME ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND/OR HAIL POSSIBLE. RECENT RADAR IMAGERY SUGGESTS THE TSTM CLUSTER SW OF LBB ALONG THE TX/NM BORDER MAY BEGIN TO FORWARD-PROPAGATE WITH SOME LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS POSSIBLE DOWNSTREAM IF COOL POOL AMALGAMATION IS REALIZED. HOWEVER...LIMITED OVERALL POTENTIAL AND ANTICIPATED ISOLATED NATURE OF ANY HAIL OR WIND GUSTS THAT DO OCCUR PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR ANY SEVERE PROBABILITIES. ..MOSIER.. 06/12/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A POTENTIAL FOR WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON FROM ERN OH ACROSS SRN AND CNTRL PA INTO NRN NJ AND SE NY. WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO AS STORMS INITIATE AND CONVECTIVE COVERAGE INCREASES WITH THE MOST LIKELY LOCATION OF THE WATCH ACROSS ERN OH INTO SRN PA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A SFC TROUGH EXTENDING SEWD ACROSS CNTRL NY INTO NRN NJ WITH A MOIST AIRMASS TO THE WEST OF THE SFC TROUGH. SFC WINDS ARE WESTERLY ACROSS MUCH OF PA INTO ERN OH WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER TO MID 60S F. AS SFC TEMPS CONTINUE TO WARM INTO THE UPPER 80S AND LOWER 90S F...A CORRIDOR OF MODERATE INSTABILITY IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP. ON THE NRN EDGE OF INSTABILITY...VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A FIELD OF CUMULUS PRESENT NEAR AND TO THE WEST OF STATE COLLEGE EXTENDING INTO NE OH WITH RADAR SHOWING SEVERAL NEW ECHOES OVER CNTRL PA AND NRN OH. THE LATEST ESRL HRRR TAKES THIS CONVECTION AND DEVELOPS SEVERAL THUNDERSTORMS OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO WITH THIS ACTIVITY MOVING SEWD ACROSS ERN OH AND SRN PA BY LATE THIS AFTERNOON. OTHER STORMS MAY DEVELOP IN SE NY ALONG THE AXIS OF STRONGEST LOW-LEVEL FLOW. THE LATEST WSR-88D VWPS ALONG THE MCD CORRIDOR INCLUDING THE PITTSBURGH 18Z SOUNDING SHOW UNIDIRECTIONAL WLY LOW TO MID-LEVEL FLOW WITH SUBSTANTIAL SPEED SHEAR IN THE LOWEST 3 KM. THIS ALONG WITH STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD SUPPORT A WIND DAMAGE THREAT WITH THE BETTER ORGANIZED MULTICELLS. HAIL COULD ALSO OCCUR WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT APPEARS LIKELY TO DEVELOP ACROSS CNTRL AND ERN MT INTO WRN ND LATE THIS AFTERNOON. WIND DAMAGE...ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO POSSIBLE. WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A 1003 MB LOW OVER NRN WY WITH AN INVERTED TROUGH EXTENDING NNWWD ACROSS ERN MT. SFC DEWPOINTS NEAR THE TROUGH ARE IN THE LOWER TO MID 60S F AND AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY IS ANALYZED FROM NRN SD WNWWD INTO ECNTRL MT WHERE MLCAPE IS ESTIMATED IN THE 1500 TO 2500 J/KG RANGE. SOUTH OF THE INSTABILITY AXIS...THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING IN NRN WY. THIS ACTIVITY IS FORECAST TO EXPAND IN COVERAGE...MOVING NWD INTO SRN AND CNTRL MT OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. IN ADDITION...WIND FIELDS ARE QUITE STRONG ACROSS THE MCD AREA WITH THE GLASGOW WSR-88D VWP SHOWING 0-6 KM SHEAR NEAR 65 KT WITH SUBSTANTIAL DIRECTIONAL AND SPEED SHEAR IN THE LOW TO MID-LEVELS. THIS WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR STORM ROTATION AND SEVERAL SUPERCELLS WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL. WIND DAMAGE WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE ESPECIALLY DUE TO THE STEEP LOW TO MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN INCREASING RISK FOR SVR TSTMS WITH LARGE HAIL...DMGG WIND GUSTS...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO EXISTS ACROSS THE AREA...AND WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION EMANATING FROM THE DEEP BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS PARTS OF WRN SD IS ENTERING A CORRIDOR OF RICHER BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MIDDLE 60S. MODIFICATIONS TO THE 21Z BIS SPECIAL RAOB TO ACCOUNT FOR THERMODYNAMIC CONDITIONS WITHIN THE MOIST CORRIDOR AHEAD OF THE CONVECTION SUGGEST STRONG INSTABILITY IN PLACE -- WITH MLCAPE AROUND 2000-3000 J/KG AND LITTLE MLCINH. THIS SUGGESTS THE POTENTIAL FOR GRADUAL INTENSIFICATION OF CONVECTION DEVELOPING ACROSS NWRN SD...THAT WILL SPREAD INTO A ZONE OF 35-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AS IT NEARS THE SD/ND BORDER. SUPERCELL CLUSTERS COULD RESULT WITH SVR HAIL/WIND...AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO. SIGNIFICANTLY SVR HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE GIVEN THE STEEP LAPSE RATES SAMPLED BY THE RAOB -- AROUND 8.5 C/KM IN THE H7-H5 LAYER. WITH STRONGER DEEP ASCENT DISPLACED TO THE W OF THE REGION...THERE IS SOME UNCERTAINTY REGARDING CONVECTIVE/SVR COVERAGE...AND CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR RISK CONTINUES ACROSS WW 246.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SVR TSTMS IS SPREADING NWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF SERN MT. THIS ACTIVITY FORMED WITHIN THE DEEP BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS NERN WY AND SERN MT...AND IS PRESENTLY ENTERING A CORRIDOR OF RELATIVELY RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE FOR THESE ELEVATIONS. SFC OBS AT GLENDIVE...BAKER...AND MILES CITY INDICATE LOWER/MIDDLE 60S DEWPOINTS EXTENDING INTO E-CNTRL MT...FOSTERING STRONG INSTABILITY OWING TO A STEEP OVERLYING MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATE PLUME. AS CONVECTION SPREADS NWD DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS...IT WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO INTENSIFY. GIVEN 50-65 KT OF MID-LEVEL FLOW SAMPLED BY THE BLX VWP...AMPLE DEEP SHEAR WILL SUPPORT SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF SVR HAIL -- SOME POSSIBLY SIGNIFICANT. AMALGAMATING COLD POOLS COULD LOCALLY ENHANCE THE SVR-WIND RISK AS CONVECTION SPREADS NWD THROUGH PARTS OF CUSTER COUNTY AND INTO PRAIRIE...DAWSON...AND MCCONE COUNTIES IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WHILE AMPLE LOW-LEVEL DIRECTIONAL SHEAR AIDED BY BACKED LOW-LEVEL FLOW MAY SUPPORT A BRIEF TORNADO RISK...SIZABLE TEMPERATURE DEWPOINT SPREADS MAY TEND TO ENCOURAGE MORE OUTFLOW-DOMINANT CONVECTION. OTHER TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS ONGOING FROM W OF BILLINGS TOWARD THE BIG HORN MOUNTAINS...IN ASSOCIATION WITH ASCENT ACCOMPANYING THE RIGHT-ENTRANCE REGION OF A HIGH-LEVEL SPEED MAX GRAZING THE AREA. THIS ACTIVITY MAY CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY AND SPREAD NWD/NNEWD ACROSS WRN PARTS OF THE WATCH AREA...POSING PRINCIPALLY A SVR HAIL RISK WITH LOCALLY SVR WIND GUSTS POSSIBLE. ..COHEN.. 06/11/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE NRN HIGH PLAINS THROUGH MID EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTIPLE CLUSTERS OF STRONG TO SEVERE TSTMS...SOME WITH A HISTORY OF PRODUCING HAIL TO 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER AND DMGG WIND GUSTS...WILL CONTINUE SPREADING NWD/NEWD ACROSS WWS 246/247. THIS ACTIVITY PRESENTLY RESIDES WITHIN A CORRIDOR OF RELATIVELY RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE /SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 50S TO MIDDLE 60S/ CIRCULATING AROUND THE NRN/WRN SEMICIRCLES OF A SFC LOW ANALYZED NEAR POWDER RIVER COUNTY MONTANA. SURMOUNTING STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES CONTINUE TO SUPPORT STRONG BUOYANCY...WITH AMPLE DEEP SHEAR MAINTAINING ORGANIZED CONVECTION INCLUDING SUPERCELLS. SVR HAIL/WIND WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE AS CONVECTION CONTINUES TO SPREAD NWD/NEWD. ANY SUSTAINED RIGHT-MOVING SUPERCELLS MAY ALSO POSE THE POTENTIAL FOR PRODUCING A BRIEF TORNADO...THOUGH NUMEROUS STORM INTERACTIONS AMIDST A NOCTURNALLY COOLING BOUNDARY LAYER COULD MITIGATE SUCH POTENTIAL. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY IMPLIES FORCING FOR ASCENT BEGINNING TO OVERTAKE THE PERIPHERY OF MOISTURE WRAPPING AROUND THE WRN SEMICIRCLE OF THE LOW. THIS CORRESPONDS TO THE RECENT UPTICK IN CONVECTION FROM ROSEBUD COUNTY TO GARFIELD COUNTY. AS FORCING FOR ASCENT CONTINUES TO INCREASE ACROSS THIS AREA...MORE ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS MAY BECOME MORE CONCENTRATED IN WRN PARTS OF WW 246...SPREADING NWD. A SWWD-ADVANCING BOUNDARY EVIDENT IN EARLIER KGGW RADAR LOOPS -- REPRESENTING THE LEADING EDGE OF COOLER AIR -- MAY HAVE A TENDENCY OF UNDERCUTTING THE DEVELOPING CONVECTION. NEVERTHELESS...THE SVR RISK MAY CONTINUE IF A COLD POOL WERE TO ORGANIZE CONCURRENT WITH THE STRONGER ASCENT. ..COHEN.. 06/12/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR RISK IS WANING ACROSS REMAINING-VALID PORTIONS OF WW 246. WHILE AN ISOLATED SVR HAIL RISK CANNOT BE RULED OUT PAST THE SCHEDULED 04Z EXPIRATION TIME...ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTIPLE TSTM CLUSTERS ARE SPREADING NWD/NEWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF ERN MT...WITH THE BACK EDGE OF THIS ACTIVITY FROM ROSEBUD COUNTY TO CUSTER COUNTY. THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD TOWARD THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. ANTECEDENT CONVECTIVE PROCESSING OF EARLIER STRONG INSTABILITY...NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION...AND THE INFLUX OF A COOLER AIR MASS FROM THE NE WILL ALL CONTINUE TO RESULT IN A LESSENING SVR RISK. REGARDLESS...WITH STRONG DEEP SHEAR ACCOMPANYING A MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX CENTERED W/NW OF THE REGION...ISOLATED MARGINALLY SVR HAIL CANNOT BE RULED OUT INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. HOWEVER... INTERACTING CONVECTIVE CELLS/CLUSTER-CONVECTION MODE WILL TEND TO MITIGATE THIS RISK. ..COHEN.. 06/12/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR RISK IS DECREASING ACROSS WW 247. HOWEVER...LIMITED POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED MARGINALLY SVR HAIL MAY EXIST DURING THE OVERNIGHT HOURS AS CONVECTION SPREADS ACROSS PARTS OF WRN/NRN ND. ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF DIURNALLY ENHANCED TSTMS CONTINUE LATE THIS EVENING OVER PORTIONS OF WRN ND AND NWRN SD...AND ARE SPREADING GENERALLY NWD/NEWD. WHILE THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE ADVANCING TOWARD THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER...ITS MOTION IS EXPECTED TO ASSUME MORE OF A W-TO-E COMPONENT AS IT ENCOUNTERS MORE OF A ZONALLY ORIENTED MID-LEVEL FLOW COMPONENT. THIS ACTIVITY WILL BE FED BY MOIST INFLOW FROM THE SE/S ACCOMPANYING AN LLJ SURMOUNTING AN ANTECEDENT COOL AIR MASS. THE BIS/MBX VWPS INDICATE SELY/SLY FLOW AROUND 30-45 KT FROM 1 TO 2 KM AGL WITH A VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE IN THE LOW LEVELS. THIS HIGHLIGHTS THE WARM-ADVECTION PATTERN THAT MAY SUSTAIN LOOSELY ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS SPREADING EWD ACROSS PARTS OF NRN ND DURING THE OVERNIGHT HOURS -- PERHAPS WITH SLIGHT SEWD/SWD DEVELOPMENT INTO THE LLJ. WITH THE 00Z BIS RAOB SAMPLING AN H7-H5 LAPSE RATE OF 8.8 C/KM...ISOLATED MARGINALLY SVR HAIL MAY OCCUR. HOWEVER...MODEST MID-LEVEL FLOW LIMITING EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...THE CLUSTER-CONVECTION MODE...AND NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION SHOULD SERVE AS FACTORS MITIGATING THE OVERALL SVR POTENTIAL INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS.
